ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, and $\angle B=30^\circ$. The perpendicular bisector of side $AC$ intersects $AC$ and $BC$ at points $E$ and $D$ respectively. If $DE=2$, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw AD, \\
$\because$AB = AC, $\angle B = 30^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle C = 30^\circ$, $\angle BAC = 120^\circ$, \\
$\because$ DE is the perpendicular bisector of AC, \\
$\therefore$ DC = DA, $\angle DEC = 90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle DAC = \angle DCA = 30^\circ$, \\
$\because$ in $\triangle DEC$, $\angle C = 30^\circ$, DE = 2, \\
$\therefore$ CD = AD = 2DE = 4, \\
$\because$ $\angle BAC = 120^\circ$, $\angle DAC = 30^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle BAD = 90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ BD = 2AD = 8, \\
$\therefore$ BC = BD + CD = 8 + 4 = \boxed{12}, \\

E 是 AC 的中点，所以 E=((0+L/2)/2,(L/(2√3)+0)/2)=(L/4,L/(4√3))。直线 AC 的斜率为 (0-L/(2√3))/(L/2-0)=-1/√3，因此 AC 的垂直平分线 ED 的斜率为 √3。过 E 的直线方程为 y-L/(4√3)=√3(x-L/4)。令 y=0 与 BC 相交，得 -L/(4√3)=√3(x-L/4)，所以 x=L/6，即 D=(L/6,0)。

于是 DE 的水平距离为 L/4-L/6=L/12，竖直距离为 L/(4√3)。所以 DE=sqrt((L/12)^2+(L/(4√3))^2)=sqrt(L^2/144+L^2/48)=sqrt(L^2/36)=L/6。已知 DE=2，因此 L/6=2，得到 L=12。所以 BC=12。

raw_record.original_question: In $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, and $\angle B=30^\circ$. The perpendicular bisector of side $AC$ intersects $AC$ and $BC$ at points $E$ and $D$ respectively. If $DE=2$, what is the length of $BC$?
raw_record.answer: Solution: Draw $AD$. Since $AB=AC$ and $\angle B=30^\circ$, we have $\angle C=30^\circ$ and $\angle BAC=120^\circ$. Since $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AC$, we get $DC=DA$ and $\angle DEC=90^\circ$. Therefore $\angle DAC=\angle DCA=30^\circ$. In $\triangle DEC$, $\angle C=30^\circ$ and $DE=2$, so $CD=AD=2DE=4$. Since $\angle BAC=120^\circ$ and $\angle DAC=30^\circ$, we have $\angle BAD=90^\circ$. Therefore $BD=2AD=8$. Hence $BC=BD+CD=8+4=\boxed{12}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, the vertex A of triangle ABC is above, and B and C are at the two ends of the base BC; point E is located on side AC, and point D is located on side BC; the dashed line ED passes through E and D, and represents the perpendicular bisector of AC.

Reasoning: Because AB = AC, triangle ABC is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles are equal. It is known that ∠B = 30°, so ∠C = 30°, thus ∠BAC = 180° - 30° - 30° = 120°.

ED is the perpendicular bisector of AC, therefore E is the midpoint of AC, ED ⟂ AC, and D is on the perpendicular bisector of AC, so DA = DC.

Connect AD. Since D is on BC, ∠ACD = ∠ACB = 30°. In triangle ADC, DA = DC, so the base angle ∠DAC = ∠ACD = 30°.

In right triangle DEC, ∠DEC = 90°, ∠DCE = 30°, and DE = 2. By the property of a 30-60-90 triangle, the hypotenuse DC = 2DE = 4. Therefore AD = DC = 4.

Also because ∠BAC = 120° and ∠DAC = 30°, ∠BAD = 120° - 30° = 90°. In right triangle ABD, ∠B = 30°, and AD = 4 is the side opposite the 30° angle, so the hypotenuse BD = 2AD = 8.

Therefore BC = BD + DC = 8 + 4 = 12.
